name: pi-tool-display
notes: Forked from MasuRii/pi-tool-display; local bashLivePreviewMode (tail live preview for running bash commands) feature intentionally diverges from upstream. The fork also adds a kind:'bash' tool-display adapter so pi-sandbox's decorated bash tool renders natively (renderBashDisplayResult extracted in tool-overrides.ts, serving both the built-in override path and the adapter; the promptGuidelines-copying registration-test assertions match upstream createBuiltinToolDisplay behavior), plus type-publishing build (rollup.dts.config.mjs, exports types -> dist/public.d.ts via prepack). 2026-09-19: tail/head preview unified — upstream formatTruncationHint gained an optional label param and buildPreviewText an optional take:'head'|'tail' param (defaults keep upstream behavior byte-stable); the fork-only formatEarlierLinesHint/buildTailPreviewText copies were removed and the unreachable empty-lines branch dropped.
